name: q
label: Question
help: The question to answer from live Google results. Pricing: https://serpkite.com/pricing; a failed answer is not billed.

name: country
label: Country
help: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), such as us, gb or de. The API uses us when this is empty.

name: language
label: Language
help: Interface language code, such as en, de or pt-br. The API uses en when this is empty.

name: location
label: Location
help: Free-text place to search around, such as Austin, Texas, United States. Local queries such as coffee need a location.

name: time
label: Time
help: Only use results from this recent period.
